 Trump administration moves to drop millions from SNAP under proposal 
 The proposal would not take effect until 2029. 
 By Arthur Jones II November 11, 2026, 9:22 AM 
 2:03 The U.S. Department of Agriculture building is seen in Washington on Dec. 7, 2024. Jose Luis Magana/AP Photo The Trump administration on Tuesday moved to kick millions of people from SNAP -- commonly known as food stamps -- and other government assistance programs for vulnerable families, according to a new proposed rule   by the U.S. Department of Agriculture.  
 An impact analysis by USDA estimates that over 6 million people could lose Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program benefits and roughly 2 million would be eliminated from receiving free school meals if families don't fit new income eligibility requirements.
